_doc: COHERENCE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): 'all surfaces, all files, all code, all instructions, everything has to work together automatically and seamlessly from the beginning.' Read by foundation/coherence.py. Every instruction surface, and every agent file workers/tools/sync_agent_files.py generates for another repository, is linted for phrases that contradict the closed-loop axiom; every rule in agents/AGENTS.md must name code that enforces it and must reach the seed copy unless it is listed platform-only. What other checks already own is not repeated here: the seed template against seed/ is FLEET-MAP-1 (fleetmap --drift, template-publish.yml), repository settings are REPO-STANDARD-1 and ADMIT-1 (repostd, admit), the definition of a system is SYSTEM-SPEC-1 and COLDSTART-1. Baselines are shrink-only: an entry may be removed when it is fixed, never added.

sources.synced_by: each copy repository's agent-files workflow pulls the generator from main daily and opens a pull request its lane merges

contradictions.why: CLOSED-LOOP-AXIOM: human-approval controls are replaced by automated gates

contradictions.why: CLOSED-LOOP-AXIOM: a legal act is a gate card with a default in effect, not a waiting review
